channel.title: jialin00.com
channel.description: Exploring web technologies, cloud computing, and AWS, while integrating philosophical perspectives. We examine technological advancements and their impact on human understanding, emphasizing the essential role of philosophy in tech-driven life.

item.title: A packet's walk through a VPC, in AWS
item.description: Open inbound 80 on a security group, leave outbound 80 closed, and the server still works. Follow one packet from the internet to an EC2 instance and watch which walls it hits, and why only one of them remembers you.

item.title: AWS has a dozen policies. They're all one shape.
